## Summary

Describe the user problem addressed by this skill change and the Slang behavior or tool contract it relies on.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate-skills.py`
- [ ] `gh skill publish --dry-run`
- [ ] Examples were added or updated for changed language/tool behavior.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate-examples.py --slangc <compatible-slangc>` was run when examples changed.
- [ ] Compatibility metadata documents required unreleased features, compiler options, tools, or network access.
- [ ] New or changed scripts have documented dependencies and side effects.
